title: Global Orchestrator Watcher
summary: Decision dossier for a global intelligent exception layer above the mechanical delivery invariants. It defines six trigger classes, the inspect-rescue-analyze-report capability ladder, a durable Problem and Decision projection into Activity across projects, uncertainty-based model routing with per-trigger planning costs, human and mechanical authority boundaries, a Control Plane plus Runner operating model, and an observe-first implementation plan with recipe-specific autonomy promotion.
